19:47 Local Time, 14:47 GMT, 20:17 IST: Nuwan Thushara bowled an outstanding final over, conceding just five runs. However, Pakistan smashed 48 runs in the three overs before that, and that has helped them get to 168/8. Sri Lanka will still be pleased with their effort, having put in a strong performance with both ball and in the field for the first time in this series. Sahibzada Farhan (76 off 47) was outstanding once again, bringing up his third consecutive fifty, but received little support from the top and middle order. Pakistan kept losing wickets before Arafat Minhas walked in at No. 8 and smashed an unbeaten 34 off just 20 deliveries to provide a late boost. The two put on 66 runs off just 37 deliveries. For Sri Lanka, Vijayakanth Viyaskanth (1/23) and Dasun Shanaka (3/23) were outstanding in the middle overs. The target looks well within reach, and Sri Lanka will fancy their chances of chasing it down and avoiding a series whitewash.
